name: one-arm-lying-dumbbell-reverse-fly.html
instructions:
1. Grab a dumbbell and position yourself with your chest flat on a bench. Your feet can be straight out behind you or used for stability on the floor.
2. Allow your arm to hang below the bench, and grab the dumbbell with a neutral grip.  This is the starting position.
3. Take a deep breath and pull the dumbbell towards the ceiling using the rear deltoids.
4. Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position under control.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, and then repeat on your opposite arm.
